bull_bear.body:
- Balance-sheet deleveraging is the stated capital story: net debt to equity ratio moved 2.6 (FY24) to 1.7 (FY25) to 0.2 (FY26); non-current borrowings fell from 18.1 to 14.3 to 0.7 crores while total shareholders' equity rose from 12.0 to 19.8 to 78.8 crores.
- Equity was raised through the NSE SME public issue of INR 42.7 crores (share capital 6.7 to 17.1 crores, reserves & surplus 13.1 to 61.7 crores between FY25 and FY26).
- Working capital absorbed the growth: FY26 Net Cash from Operating Activities was -19.1 crores against +2.0 (FY24) and +2.5 (FY25), with trade receivables rising 25.3 to 48.7 crores and debtor days at 181 (FY26) vs 128 (FY25) and 120 (FY24).
- Return metrics as labelled: ROE 17.0% / 46.6% / 24.4% and ROCE 21.3% / 40.9% / 36.8% for FY24 / FY25 / FY26. No dividend policy is disclosed anywhere in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Deck frames the company as a diversified specialty performance chemicals platform serving Textile and Garment Washing, Home and Personal Care, Institutional and Industrial Cleaners, Water Treatment, Paints and Coatings, Paper and Pulp, Construction and Rubber, and Dyes and Pigments.
- Claims "Solution-led, not commoditized, engagement" backed by 350+ customized formulations, an in-house R&D lab and 40 registered trademarks across representative brands (Evenol, Ampinol, Klarizym, Glidex, Revilon, Astasoft etc.).
- Distribution moat claimed as 50+ pan-India authorized distributors; the deck states "225+ domestic customers" on the glance page and "200+ domestic customers annually" in the Right-to-Win section (both readings quoted as printed).
- Customer presence in 12 countries; named export/partner geographies include Australia, Bangladesh, Egypt, Indonesia, Singapore, Ukraine, Thailand, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, Canada, South Korea and Turkey.
- "Four decades of enabling growth": partnership Vinayak Dyes (1978), first facility at Isanpur, Narol (1982), renamed Neochem Technologies (2006), private limited conversion (2017), listed on NSE SME raising INR 42.7 crores.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Name change] Formerly Neochem Bio Solutions Private Limited and, before that, Neochem Technologies Private Limited; converted to a public limited company in connection with the NSE SME listing.
- [Listing status] Listed on the NSE SME platform ("N S E - S M E : N E O C H E M"), not the main board.
- [Board] Chairman & Non-Executive Director Mr. Dinesh Chopra previously led sales/business development at BASF India and Honeywell India; Managing Director Mr. Swapnil Rameshbhai Makati (20+ years) and Whole Time Director Ms. Hemangini Swapnil Dathia (16+ years) have been with the company since inception.
- [Industry framing, third-party] CareEdge Research estimates cited: domestic specialty chemicals market Rs 2.20 lakh crores (FY19) to Rs 5.00 lakh crores (FY25E) to Rs 7.50 lakh crores (FY29P); domestic textile chemicals Rs 0.15 lakh crores (FY19) to Rs 0.30 lakh crores (FY25E) to Rs 0.50 lakh crores (FY29P), with CAGR labels of 9%, 10%, 10-12% and 12-14% printed alongside but not reliably bound to a specific series in the extraction.
- [IR] Investor relations handled by NeoAtlas Capital Advisory LLP; company IR contact investors@neochem.in.

deepdive.thesis: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited (NSE SME: NEOCHEM) positions itself as "The Backbone of India's Industrial Chemistry" — a 40+ year-old, promoter-led Ahmedabad manufacturer of specialty performance chemicals (polymers, surfactants, silicones, esters and bio-based solutions) selling customised, solution-led formulations across textiles, home & personal care, cleaning, water treatment, paints, paper and construction.
